prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1401; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the rear quarter panel and left taillamp assembly shows crush and scuffing consistent with a side-on contact during a left turn, and the pattern of deformation lines up with the account given. Structural measurements were taken and the bracket and bumper cover replacement is proposed, with paint blending on the adjacent panel. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the work shown. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the photos provided. Two similar invoice charges posted on the same day are under review with the shop before payment is approved.
